title: Sparkly yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='yoyoFace' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9fd6'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e8467f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81e58'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50 8 C 50 16, 48 20, 50 26' stroke='#9ef2ff' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M22 22 l2.5 6 6 2.5 -6 2.5 -2.5 6 -2.5 -6 -6 -2.5 6 -2.5 z'/>
    <path d='M79 18 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z' fill='#9ef2ff'/>
    <path d='M84 62 l2.5 6 6 2.5 -6 2.5 -2.5 6 -2.5 -6 -6 -2.5 6 -2.5 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <path d='M16 66 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z' fill='#c9a6ff'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='12' r='2' fill='#c9a6ff'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='82' r='2.5' fill='#9ef2ff'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='40' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#9ef2ff'/>
  </g>
  <!-- left disc -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='56' rx='12' ry='30' fill='#3fd0e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='56' rx='7' ry='22' fill='#a8f4ff'/>
  <!-- right disc -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='56' rx='12' ry='30' fill='#3fd0e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='56' rx='7' ry='22' fill='#a8f4ff'/>
  <!-- body/front face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='16' ry='30' fill='url(#yoyoFace)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='11' ry='22' fill='#ffd6ec' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='6' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='3' fill='#fff6c2'/>
  <!-- shine -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='40' rx='3' ry='7' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
